name: Threads
label: Threads — API v1.0 posts, replies, insights
description: Official Threads API v1.0 on https://graph.threads.net/v1.0 (graph.threads.com is an equivalent host; not Facebook Graph). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Two-step publish: container create then threads_publish (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/posts/). Also media get, replies, media insights. threads_user_token is never logged or returned. Profile cap 250 published posts / 24 h. Do not scrape threads.net. Customer owns the Meta Threads app.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put threads_user_token here. Example: {"operation":"thread_create","threads_user_id":"123","media_type":"TEXT","text":"Hello"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: thread_create | thread_publish | thread_get | reply_create | insights_get | trigger.

schema.label: threads_user_id
schema.description: Path {threads_user_id} for thread_create, thread_publish, and reply_create. Use me if the token allows.

schema.label: media_type
schema.description: thread_create / reply_create: TEXT | IMAGE | VIDEO | CAROUSEL.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Post/reply text. Official max 500 characters. Do not log.

schema.label: image_url
schema.description: Public image URL Meta can fetch (thread_create).

schema.label: video_url
schema.description: Public video URL Meta can fetch (thread_create).

schema.label: metric
schema.description: insights_get query metric (views, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, clicks, shares, …).

schema.label: creation_id
schema.description: thread_publish body creation_id — container id returned by thread_create. Official second step (POST /{threads-user-id}/threads_publish). Wait ~30s after container create for media. Docs: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/posts/

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (container/media/insights JSON). trigger is ingress. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (container id, media object, or insights). Do not log post text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT includes thread_publish (official second publish step). trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Threads user token
configurationParameters.description: Threads access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Example: 30.
